info.name: Babylon: Auth and Public
info.description:
Auth, staff accounts, the report assistant and the public pages.
No scripts. Send each request by hand and read the answer yourself.
Run the folders top to bottom: Auth, then Staff accounts, then AI assistant, then Public.
Needs the demo accounts and issues from `npm run seed:public`, and the staff settings (STAFF_ACCESS_CODE, DEPARTMENT_CODES, EMPLOYEE_ROSTER) in backend/.env.
Tokens and ids are passed on by hand: when a Description says 'copy data.token into the collection variable X', open the collection's Variables tab and paste it there. Never save your own codes back into this file.
Every Description says what answer to expect.

item.name: 1 Sign up a new citizen: 201 and a token

request.description:
Expected: 201. data.token is a string, data.user.role = citizen, data.user.email is the email you sent, and the answer has no passwordHash.
Before sending: set the collection variable newEmail to an address nobody used yet (for example postman-1@example.com, then postman-2@example.com on the next full run).
After: copy data.token into the collection variable newToken.
Expected: 409. code = conflict, field = email. Sends the same newEmail as request 1.

item.name: 3 Sign up asking to be admin: 400

request.description: Expected: 400. field = role. A sign-up with role admin is refused, never quietly turned into a citizen.
Expected: 400. field = password (at least 6 characters).

item.name: 5 Log in with the new account: 200

request.description: Expected: 200. data.user.email is newEmail. No passwordHash in the answer.

item.name: 6 Log in as the demo citizen: 200

request.description:
Expected: 200. data.user.role = citizen, data.token is a string, no passwordHash.
After: copy data.token into the collection variable citizenToken.

Expected: 401. code = unauthorized.
After: keep this answer open. Request 8 must give exactly the same body.
Expected: 401, with exactly the same code and message as request 7 (the app never says which emails exist).

item.name: 9 Staff account at the citizen door: 403 staff-account

request.description: Expected: 403. code = staff-account. A staff email on the citizen door is refused after the password is right.

item.name: 10 Citizen at the staff door: 403 citizen-account

request.description: Expected: 403. code = citizen-account. A citizen email on the staff door is refused after the password is right.

item.name: 11 Wrong password at the wrong door stays 401

request.description: Expected: 401. code = unauthorized. A wrong password stays 401 even at the wrong door, so the door never leaks the account type.

item.name: 12 Department officer at the staff door: 200

request.description:
Expected: 200. data.user.role = department, data.user.department = Roads & Highways.
After: copy data.token into the collection variable deptToken.

Expected: 200. data.user.role = admin.
After: copy data.token into the collection variable adminToken.
Expected: 400. field = door.
Expected: 401. code = unauthorized. No Authorization header is sent on purpose.

item.name: 16 Me as the demo citizen: 200, no hash

request.description:
Expected: 200. data.email = citizen@babylon.test. A citizen gets only id, name, email, role, department, onboarded. No passwordHash.
Needs the collection variable citizenToken (request 6).

Expected: 200. data.department = Roads & Highways. A staff account also gets jobTitle, phone, phoneVerified, employeeId, employeeIdVerified, departmentVerified, photo and setupMissing (a list of what the setup still needs).
Needs the collection variable deptToken (request 12).

Expected: 400. field = current (the current password is wrong).
Needs the collection variable newToken (request 1).

item.name: 19 Change password, same as current: 400 new

request.description:
Expected: 400. field = new (the new password must differ from the current one).
Needs newToken.

Expected: 400. field = new (at least 6 characters).
Needs newToken.
Expected: 401. No Authorization header is sent on purpose.

Expected: 200. data = null. The password is changed to second-pass-2.
Needs newToken.

item.name: 23 The old password no longer logs in: 401

request.description: Expected: 401. The old password first-pass-1 no longer works.
Expected: 200. The new password second-pass-2 works.

Expected: 200. The server keeps no list of tokens; logging out only means the app forgets the token.
Needs newToken.

Expected: 201. data.user.role = department, data.user.onboarded = false, data.user.setupMissing lists 4 things (a job title, a verified phone number, a verified Employee ID, a verified department code). No passwordHash, and the access code is not in the answer.
Before sending: set the collection variables staffEmail (an address nobody used, for example staff-1@example.com) and staffAccessCode (the STAFF_ACCESS_CODE from your backend/.env).
After: copy data.token into the collection variable staffToken. This token says onboarded: false.
Expected: 400. code = invalid, field = accessCode. Nothing is created.
Expected: 409. code = conflict, field = email. Sends the same staffEmail as request 1 with the right access code.
Expected: 400. field = role. Only department and admin are allowed here.
Expected: 400. field = department (a department account must name its department).

Expected: 201. data.user.role = admin and data.user.department = null (a department sent with an admin is dropped). setupMissing has 3 things: no department code is needed for an admin.
Before sending: staffAccessCode must be set (request 1).

item.name: 7 Me as the new staff account: setup not done

request.description:
Expected: 200. data.onboarded = false, data.setupMissing lists what is still needed, data.employeeIdVerified = false.
Needs the collection variable staffToken (request 1).

item.name: 8 The new token cannot open the department area yet: 403

request.description:
Expected: 403, code forbidden: 'Please finish setting up your staff account first.' A staff token that is not onboarded is refused by every panel route.
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 409. code = conflict. The setup is not complete, so nothing changes and no new token is given.
Needs staffToken.
Expected: 401. No Authorization header is sent on purpose.

item.name: 11 Department code with a citizen token: 403

request.description:
Expected: 403, code forbidden. A citizen is not staff.
Needs the collection variable citizenToken (Auth request 6).

Expected: 400. field = code. The message names the department but never shows the right code.
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 200. data.departmentVerified = true, and 'a verified department code' is gone from data.setupMissing.
Before sending: set the collection variable departmentCode to this department's code (DEPARTMENT_CODES in your backend/.env, the Roads & Highways one).
Needs staffToken.

item.name: 14 Employee ID, not on the list: 400

request.description:
Expected: 400. field = employeeId. The message says the ID is not on the Roads & Highways staff list.
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 200. data.employeeId is the ID in capitals, data.employeeIdVerified = true.
Before sending: set the collection variable employeeId to an ID from the Roads & Highways list in EMPLOYEE_ROSTER (backend/.env) that no other account holds.
A second account asking for the same ID gets 409 conflict. A verified ID cannot be changed (409).
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 400. field = jobTitle (2 to 60 characters).
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 200. data.name and data.jobTitle are saved, and 'a job title' is gone from setupMissing. An employeeId sent here is ignored on purpose: it can only come from request 15.
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 400. field = photo. Only a WebP, PNG or JPEG data URL under 300,000 characters is accepted.
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 200. data.photo is the data URL you sent. Send {"photo": ""} to remove it.
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 400. field = phone (11 digits, 013 to 019; +880 is accepted).
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 200. data = { phone: 01711000111, resendAfter: 30 }. The code itself is never in the answer. In dev mode (PHONE_CODE_MODE=dev) the code is 123456.
Send it again at once: 429 too-many-requests ('Please wait N seconds').
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 400. field = code, message 'That code is not right. You have 2 tries left.' After 3 wrong codes: 423 locked.
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 200. data.phone = 01711000111, data.phoneVerified = true, and 'a verified phone number' is gone from setupMissing.
If request 22 locked you: wait for the code to be sent again (request 21 after 30 seconds).
Needs staffToken.

Expected: 200. data.user.onboarded = true, data.user.setupMissing = [], and data.token is a NEW token with onboarded true.
After: copy data.token into the collection variable staffToken (replace the old one). Then run request 25.
Needs staffToken with every step above done.

item.name: 25 The fresh token opens the department area: 200

request.description:
Expected: 200. The same request as request 8 now works, because the token says onboarded: true.
Needs the NEW staffToken from request 24.

Expected: 200. data.onboarded = true, data.setupMissing = [], and jobTitle, phone, employeeId, photo are the saved values (this is what the profile page shows after a reload).
Needs the NEW staffToken.
Expected: 401. No Authorization header is sent on purpose.

item.name: 2 F6 assistant with a department token: 403

request.description:
Expected: 403, code forbidden. Only citizens use the report assistant.
Needs the collection variable deptToken (Auth request 12).

Expected: 400. field = photoUrl. Nothing is sent to Gemini.
Needs citizenToken.

Expected: 400. field = category (one of Roads, Waste, Water, Lighting, Bridges).
Needs citizenToken.

Expected: 200. data = { category, description }. category is one of the 5 categories or null; description is 10 to 500 characters.
Replace PASTE_PHOTO_DATA_URL with a real photo as a data URL. In PowerShell: "data:image/jpeg;base64," + [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("C:\\path\\pothole.jpg")) | Set-Clipboard
Needs GEMINI_API_KEY in backend/.env and citizenToken.
With the key removed and the server restarted: 503, code ai-unavailable. More than 6 requests in a minute: 429 too-many-requests.
Expected: 401. No Authorization header is sent on purpose.

Expected: 400. field = text (at least 10 characters, at most 2000).
Needs citizenToken.

Expected: 200. data = { summary }: one line of at most 70 characters.
Needs GEMINI_API_KEY in backend/.env and citizenToken.
With the key removed and the server restarted: 503, code ai-unavailable. More than 10 requests in a minute: 429 too-many-requests.
Expected: 200. data.status = up.

item.name: 2 Guest list: all 12 issues, ranked 1 to 12

request.description:
Expected: 200. 12 issues, rank 1 to 12 in order. The first is 'Deep pothole near Wasa Circle'. Each has id and votes. No pendingAfterImg, departmentNote, reporterEmail or imageEmbedding anywhere, and no voted flag for a guest.
After: copy data[0].id into the collection variable issueId.
Expected: 200. At least one issue, and every one is category Roads and status open.
Expected: 200. 'All' means no filter, so there are 12 issues.

item.name: 5 Search ignores case, matches title or street

request.description: Expected: 200. At least one issue. The search ignores case and matches the title or the street; every title or location contains 'pothole'.

item.name: 6 With a position, every issue has distanceM

request.description: Expected: 200. Every issue has a numeric distanceM.

item.name: 7 A category that does not exist: 400

request.description: Expected: 400. field = category.
Expected: 400. A latitude without a longitude is refused.

item.name: 9 Signed in: my two reports are mine and voted

request.description:
Expected: 200. Every issue has voted and mine (true or false). Exactly two are mine, and both have voted = true.
Needs the collection variable citizenToken (request 6 in Auth).

item.name: 10 A broken token is just a guest: 200

request.description: Expected: 200. A broken token is treated as a guest: 12 issues and no mine flag.

Expected: 200. data.id equals the issueId you saved. No pendingAfterImg in the answer.
Needs the collection variable issueId (request 2 of this folder).
Expected: 404. code = not-found.
Expected: 200. data.slides has 3 items and data.categories has at least one.
Expected: 200. data has four numbers: received, resolved, avgDays, reopenedPercent.

item.name: 15 Fixed this week: up to 3 resolved, with an after-photo

request.description: Expected: 200. 1 to 3 issues, each status resolved with an afterImg.

item.name: 16 Recent activity: 8 by default, newest first

request.description: Expected: 200. 8 items by default, newest first (createdAt falls down the list).
Expected: 200. Exactly 3 items.
Expected: 400. field = limit.
